pattern.abbr.backLoopMeaning: back loop only: work into the back loop of each stitch, which gives a sharp edge and keeps the bottom flat
pattern.abbr.magicRingMeaning: adjustable loop to start crocheting in the round; pull the tail to close the centre
pattern.embroiderAboveEye: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} above {eye}
pattern.embroiderBeforeClosing: Embroider the details with a tapestry needle before you close the part, so you can fasten off the ends inside
pattern.embroiderBelowEye: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} below {eye}
pattern.embroiderWidth: {count, plural, one {# stitch} other {# stitches}} wide
pattern.eyeSpacing: {count, plural, one {# stitch} other {# stitches}} from {other}
pattern.eyesBeforeClosing: Fix the eyes in place before you stuff and close the part
pattern.eyesSupply: {count, plural, one {# safety eye} other {# safety eyes}} of {size} mm
pattern.fastenOffFlat: Fasten off, leaving a long tail to sew the circle on
pattern.fastenOffMotif: Fasten off and leave a long tail to sew it on
pattern.fastenOffMushroom: Fasten off, stuff the cap lightly and sew it onto the stem with the opening
pattern.fastenOffOval: Fasten off, leaving a long tail to sew the oval on
pattern.fastenOffTube: Fasten off, leaving a long tail to sew the tube on
pattern.finishedSizeValue: about {height} cm tall and {width} cm wide
pattern.hookSupplyFallback: Crochet hook: one size smaller than the yarn label says, for firm stitches
pattern.howToRead.count: total number of stitches at the end of the row
pattern.howToRead.range: repeat the same instruction for each of these rows
pattern.howToRead.repeat: repeat what is between the brackets 6 times
pattern.ovalStart: ch {chains}; starting in the 2nd ch from the hook: 3sc in that ch, {middle}sc, 3sc in the last ch, then along the other side of the chain {middle}sc
pattern.phrase.chainStart: ch {chains}; starting in the 2nd ch from the hook: {stitches}
pattern.phrase.firstLobe: First lobe: continue over the first {stitches} stitches only
pattern.phrase.heartBorder: Border: do not turn; work 1sc in each row end and each stitch all around the heart, with 2sc in the point at the bottom; join with 1sl st in the first st
pattern.phrase.inEachOfNext: {stitch} in each of the next {count} st
pattern.phrase.intoSecondChain: ch {chains}; {stitches} in the 2nd ch from the hook
pattern.phrase.otherSide: along the other side of the chain: {stitches}
pattern.phrase.roundAround: 1sc in each st around, with ({tip}) in the ch-space at the tip
pattern.phrase.secondLobe: Second lobe: join the yarn in the next stitch of row {row} and work over the remaining {stitches} stitches
pattern.rowsNote: Flat parts worked in rows: increase and decrease in the first and last stitch of the row.
pattern.rowsStart: ch {chains}; starting in the 2nd ch from the hook: {stitches}sc
pattern.spiralNote: Work in a continuous spiral without joining the rows. Place a stitch marker in the first stitch of each row so you don't lose count.
pattern.startStuffing: Start stuffing firmly now, and keep adding stuffing as you decrease
pattern.stuffLightly: Stuff lightly, leaving the open end unstuffed so it is easy to sew on
pattern.stuffOpening: Stuff firmly, leave a long tail and sew the opening onto the other part
pattern.toolsSupply: Stitch marker, tapestry needle and scissors
pattern.tubeStart: ch {chains} and join with a sl st into a ring (without twisting); 1sc in each ch
pattern.yarnEstimateNote: Estimate based on the number of stitches, with some margin.

shapebar.title: Shapes
shapes.Arm.hint: Open tube with a rounded top: arm, leg, tail
shapes.Bottle.hint: Flat base, round belly, narrow neck, open rim: pot, vase, bottle
shapes.Cone.hint: From a point (or flat top) to an open base: ear, snout, horn, pointy hat, leg
shapes.Cylinder.hint: Closed with a flat bottom and top: body, foot, hat
shapes.Disc.hint: A single flat layer: flat ear, eye patch, belly patch
shapes.Dome.hint: Rounded cap with an open bottom: hat, muzzle. Make it taller for an arm, leg or tail
shapes.Drop.hint: From a point to a round base: flame, onion, teardrop, bird body
shapes.Embroidery.hint: Mouth, nose, eyebrow or cheek; place it on the head
shapes.Eye.hint: Safety eye (10 mm); put it on the head with Attach
shapes.Flower.hint: Flat flower: a circle with petals around it
shapes.Heart.hint: Flat heart worked in rows: on a tummy, a cushion, a cheek
shapes.Leaf.hint: Flat leaf worked in rows, point to point: leaf, fin, feather
shapes.MushroomCap.hint: Round cap with an inward-curling rim and an opening for the stem: mushroom, jellyfish
shapes.OpenSphere.hint: Ball with an opening: muzzle (open at the back) or a body the head sits on
shapes.Oval.hint: One flat layer around a foundation chain: foot sole, belly patch, flat ear
shapes.Patch.hint: Flat patch worked in rows: scarf, wing, blanket, book
shapes.OpenPeanut.hint: Peanut with an opening at the top: a body to put the head on
shapes.Peanut.hint: Two balls in one piece: peanut, snowman, body and head in one
shapes.Sphere.hint: Ball, oval, egg or pear: head, body, nose
shapes.Star.hint: Flat star: a circle with points around it
shapes.Tube.hint: Open at both ends: neck, sleeve, scarf, collar
stripes.direction.Arm: Round 1 is the rounded top, round {rows} the open end.
stripes.direction.Bottle: Round 1 is the centre of the base, round {rows} the rim at the top.
stripes.direction.Cone: Round 1 is the tip (or the centre of the top), round {rows} the edge.
stripes.direction.Cylinder: Round 1 is the centre of the bottom, round {rows} the centre of the top.
stripes.direction.Disc: Round 1 is the centre, round {rows} the edge.
stripes.direction.Dome: Round 1 is the top, round {rows} the edge.
stripes.direction.Drop: Round 1 is the tip, round {rows} the base.
stripes.direction.Flower: Round 1 is the centre, round {rows} the petals.
stripes.direction.Heart: Row 1 is the point at the bottom, row {rows} the top of the lobes.
stripes.direction.Leaf: Round 1 goes around the chain in the middle of the leaf, round {rows} is the edge.
stripes.direction.MushroomCap: Round 1 is the top of the cap, round {rows} the opening underneath.
stripes.direction.OpenSphere: Round 1 is the centre opposite the opening, round {rows} the edge of the opening.
stripes.direction.Oval: Row 1 is the middle (around the chain), row {rows} the edge.
stripes.direction.Patch: Row 1 is the bottom, row {rows} the top.
stripes.direction.OpenPeanut: Round 1 is the bottom, round {rows} the open top.
stripes.direction.Peanut: Round 1 is the top, round {rows} the bottom.
stripes.direction.Sphere: Round 1 is the top, round {rows} the bottom.
stripes.direction.Star: Round 1 is the centre, round {rows} the points.
stripes.direction.Tube: Row 1 is the bottom, row {rows} the top.
